text.arabic_uthmani: لَقَدْ كَانَ لِسَبَإٍۢ فِى مَسْكَنِهِمْ ءَايَةٌۭ ۖ جَنَّتَانِ عَن يَمِينٍۢ وَشِمَالٍۢ ۖ كُلُوا۟ مِن رِّزْقِ رَبِّكُمْ وَٱشْكُرُوا۟ لَهُۥ ۚ بَلْدَةٌۭ طَيِّبَةٌۭ وَرَبٌّ غَفُورٌۭ

words.gloss_range: emphatic assertion particle prefixed to the opening perfect frame
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) makes the Saba report enter as certified evidence before any scenery appears. The sign is heard from the first beat as an accountable fact, not as neutral historical color.

topics.headline: emphatic certified onset
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sign is framed as already secured evidence before the gardens are described.
topics.reason: The emphatic particle joins the following perfect frame and scopes over the initial existence claim.

words.gloss_range: certification particle before the perfect verb, giving realized past force
words.prose: {{ar:قَدْ}} ({{tr:qad}}) adds completed evidentiary force to the perfect verb. The ayah asks the listener to receive Saba’s sign as a realized fact lodged in their past, with the clipped {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) plus {{ar:قَدْ}} ({{tr:qad}}) onset audibly front-loading certainty.

topics.headline: realized past proof
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sign is presented as completed evidence, not a possibility still awaiting proof.
topics.reason: The particle directly precedes the perfect verb and participates in the emphatic perfect construction.

words.gloss_range: past existential or copular verb establishing the sign-state before it is specified
words.root_gloss_range: being, becoming, standing in existence; here narrowed to an established past sign-state
words.prose: {{ar:كَانَ}} ({{tr:kāna}}) makes existence itself the opening argument: there had been a sign for Saba. Its dependents come forward before {{ar:ءَايَةٌۭ}} ({{tr:āyatun}}), so recipient and habitat frame the proof before the sign is named; the final verbless evaluation later freezes that established being into land-quality and Lordly mercy.

topics.headline: past existential establishment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Saba’s abundance is not just described; it is established as a past reality that can ground accountability.
topics.reason: The local form is a perfect verb governing an existential/copular clause with a delayed subject.

topics.headline: recipient and habitat before sign noun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that who receives the sign and where it stands are interpretive facts before the sign noun appears.
topics.reason: The lām and fī phrases precede the delayed nominative subject and are licensed by local syntax.

topics.headline: existence answers final evaluation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah moving from asserted being to stable evaluation, with visible proof and lordship held together.
topics.reason: The cooccurrence and echo rows support a local movement from the opening existence claim to the closing nominal verdict.

words.gloss_range: fronted lām of assignment, relevance, benefit, and liability
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) assigns the sign to Saba before the dwelling phrase localizes it. The preposition keeps favor and accountability together: the sign is for them as benefit and against them as readable evidence if the gift is misread.

topics.headline: sign assigned to Saba
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Saba is made the concerned party before the place is described.
topics.reason: The prefixed preposition governs the proper name and participates in the fronted predicate domain of the clause.

words.gloss_range: proper name governed by lām; a named polity treated as accountable community
words.root_gloss_range: proper-name field; local force comes from governance, collectivity, and rare specificity
words.prose: {{ar:سَبَإٍۢ}} ({{tr:sabaʾin}}) is not a generic prosperous people. The proper name is governed as the recipient of the sign, then the plural suffix in {{ar:مَسْكَنِهِمْ}} ({{tr:maskanihim}}) turns the named polity into accountable persons; variant final realizations affect recited surface, not that recipient role. Compared with reported news of Saba (27:22), this occurrence makes Saba the certified object lesson inside its own habitat.

topics.headline: named polity as accountable recipient
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that prosperity is anchored to a named community whose own inhabited place becomes evidence.
topics.reason: The proper noun is governed by lām and resumed by a plural possessive suffix in the dwelling phrase.

topics.headline: variant endings preserve recipient role
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that recitation variation changes final sound or case surface without moving Saba out of the sign-recipient slot.
topics.reason: The prefixed lām remains the governing relation, so the variants are apparatus for surface realization rather than a different local syntax.

topics.headline: from reported Saba to object lesson
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shift from Saba as reported news (27:22) to Saba as a certified lesson in its own habitat.
topics.reason: The inter-ayah row gives a concrete recurrence contrast and does not override the local governed role.

words.gloss_range: preposition locating the sign inside the inhabited domain
words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) makes the dwelling the proof-field. The evidence is not remote scenery; it is placed inside ordinary habitation after {{ar:لِسَبَإٍ}} ({{tr:li-sabaʾin}}) has already assigned the sign to the people.

topics.headline: habitation as evidentiary sphere
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Saba’s evidence sits inside daily lived space rather than at a distant marvel-site.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the dwelling noun and follows the recipient phrase as a distinct location slot.

words.gloss_range: their settled dwelling or habitat, locally singular collective with variant plural scale
words.root_gloss_range: settling, stillness, dwelling; here an inhabited stability where the sign is located
words.prose: {{ar:مَسْكَنِهِمْ}} ({{tr:maskanihim}}) makes the sign stand in their own settled habitat. The root pressure of stillness turns ordinary stability into readable proof, while the singular/plural reading contrast widens the same point from one communal home-sphere to many domestic spaces. The dwelling is paired with gardens and provision, unlike the lodged family without cultivation in 14:37, and the later land-quality shows a whole livable order rather than private housing alone.

topics.headline: their dwelling as local proof
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sign is embedded in Saba’s own stable living space, making accountability domestic and ordinary.
topics.reason: The noun is governed by fī and bears the third-person plural possessive suffix referring back to Saba.

topics.headline: singular and plural dwelling scale
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sign can be heard at the scale of a shared habitat or distributed homes, while the canonical local form remains the singular collective.
topics.reason: The variant plural is useful for scale contrast, but it does not replace the aligned local singular surface.

topics.headline: dwelling linked to gardens and land verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that settlement, gardens, provision, and the good-land verdict interpret one another as a civic-ecological gift.
topics.reason: The echo rows connect the dwelling phrase to adjacent gardens, later provision address, and the closing land evaluation; 14:37 supplies a contrast in settledness and cultivation.

words.gloss_range: indefinite sign or proof, delayed as the subject and specified by the two gardens
words.root_gloss_range: visible marker or evidence; local context selects readable proof rather than abstract signhood alone
words.prose: {{ar:ءَايَةٌۭ}} ({{tr:āyatun}}) names signhood before the gardens specify its material form. The word turns abundance into evidence to be read, then the imperatives disclose the required response: consume from provision and give thanks. Natural-sign pressure like 2:164 is localized in agriculture, while later Saba responses sharpen the contrast between visible sign and rejection (34:19; 34:43); any shelter-return resonance is only a background contour because the local syntax selects visible proof.

topics.headline: sign before material specification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the category of proof before seeing the two gardens that fill it out.
topics.reason: The noun is the delayed subject of the opening verb and is specified by the following dual garden noun.

topics.headline: visible proof over etymological spread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the gardens are resources only secondarily; first they are readable evidence placed in ordinary perception.
topics.reason: The root discussion is kept where it supports visible evidence, but the local gardens and commands select sign-mark value over a shelter-return derivation.

topics.headline: sign answered by command and mercy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that visible signhood is framed by certainty, command-response, and mercy, with later Saba responses sharpening the contrast (34:19; 34:43).
topics.reason: The rows connect local signhood with natural-sign language (2:164), surah-local response material (34:19; 34:43), and the command pair inside this ayah.

words.gloss_range: dual gardens specifying the sign as paired, flanking, sheltered abundance
words.root_gloss_range: covering, enclosure, hiddenness; locally concrete garden-canopy and productive shelter
words.prose: {{ar:جَنَّتَانِ}} ({{tr:jannatāni}}) concretizes the sign as two gardens. The dual is countable and spatially balanced, matching right and left, while the covering root-image makes provision feel sheltered and enclosed; after the concealed beings of 34:14, covered gardens become visible proof.

topics.headline: two gardens as balanced sign
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sign is not vague lushness but a paired spatial arrangement around the settlement.
topics.reason: The dual nominative specifies the sign and aligns with the following right-left side phrase.

topics.headline: sheltered garden-cover image
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a contrast between hiddenness that fails to know in 34:14 and covered abundance made visible as proof here.
topics.reason: The root-field supports canopy and cover locally; the comparison to two gardens in 55:46 remains a contrast, not the governing sense.

words.gloss_range: preposition marking side-orientation for the garden pair
words.prose: {{ar:عَن}} ({{tr:ʿan}}) does not make the gardens simply separate from the settlement. It governs the side phrase and stretches across both coordinates, so the gardens read as flanking abundance arranged around the habitat.

topics.headline: one preposition for two flanks
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that right and left share one spatial frame, making provision surround rather than drift into separate locations.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the right-side noun and extends over the coordinated left-side noun in the local phrase.

words.gloss_range: right side within the governed side phrase, with favorable coloring kept subordinate to literal orientation
words.root_gloss_range: right side, oath, strength, auspiciousness; locally a spatial flank colored by favor
words.prose: {{ar:يَمِينٍۢ}} ({{tr:yamīnin}}) opens the right-left coordinate frame under {{ar:عَن}} ({{tr:ʿan}}). It is literal side-language, but its favorable rightness colors the abundance as benefaction; wider right-side destiny echoes such as 56:8 remain secondary to the local flanking geometry.

topics.headline: first governed side of the gardens
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the dual gardens become an ordered layout, not an unspecified quantity of vegetation.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive under the preposition and starts the lateral frame completed by the next side word.

topics.headline: right-side favor without importing destiny system
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the right flank has favorable coloring, while the ayah is still mapping provision rather than assigning eschatological ranks.
topics.reason: The blessing/right-hand field is relevant as coloring, but local grammar keeps the noun inside a spatial side phrase; 56:8 is contrastive background.

words.gloss_range: conjunction coordinating the second side with the first
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) binds the left side to the right side without sequence. The phrase becomes a simultaneous lateral pair, tightening the image of balanced provision around the dwelling before the command begins.

topics.headline: compact right-left coordination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the two sides function together as one balanced spatial bracket.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the second side noun with the first inside the same prepositional frame.

words.gloss_range: left side coordinated under the same side phrase, completing the lateral enclosure
words.root_gloss_range: left, north, inclusion or encompassing; locally the second flank completing spatial coverage
words.prose: {{ar:شِمَالٍۢ}} ({{tr:shimālin}}) inherits the same prepositional frame and closes the right-left bracket. Its encompassing field helps the left flank complete surrounding provision, while ruin associations such as 56:41 remain contrastive because this pre-fall scene is still abundance.

topics.headline: left flank under shared governance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the dwelling rhetorically encircled by provision rather than supplied from only one side.
topics.reason: The coordinated genitive remains under the side-orientation phrase and completes the spatial merism.

topics.headline: formulaic leftness without local ruin
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a marked right-left formula of total orientation, while the left is not yet a symbol of ruin in this ayah.
topics.reason: The uncommon side-pair pattern sharpens spatial totality; 56:41 is retained as contrast because local syntax keeps the word in a provision scene.

words.gloss_range: second-person plural imperative to eat, objectless but restricted by a source phrase
words.root_gloss_range: eating, consuming, using resources; locally commanded communal intake from attributed provision
words.prose: {{ar:كُلُوا۟}} ({{tr:kulū}}) pivots from landscape to address. The command has no direct object, so consumption stays open but is immediately bounded by source: eat from the provision of your Lord. Bodily use of bounty is allowed, yet it becomes an accountable communal act rather than autonomous ownership; after eating exposed hidden truth in 34:14, the same consumption field becomes grateful human use here, with 2:172 supplying a concrete eat-and-thank parallel.

topics.headline: commanded eating bounded by source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that enjoyment is authorized only inside attribution to the provider.
topics.reason: The imperative lacks a direct object and is restricted by the following min phrase.

topics.headline: description becomes communal address
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices scenery turning into a speech-act directed at the community.
topics.reason: The second-person plural command changes the discourse mode from description to direct obligation.

topics.headline: consumption from disclosure to gratitude
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that eating moves from a disclosure mechanism in 34:14 to grateful human use in 34:15, with 2:172 providing a parallel of eating and thanking.
topics.reason: The inter-ayah rows connect the consumption field across the boundary and to a concrete eat-and-thank formula (2:172).

words.gloss_range: source or partitive preposition after the eating command
words.prose: {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}) is the hinge between eating and provision. It makes use partitive and sourced: they eat from a larger supply, so consumption never equals total ownership.

topics.headline: eating from a larger supply
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command grants access to provision without letting use become possession.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the provision noun after the objectless eating command and supplies source or partitive force.

words.gloss_range: provision or apportioned sustenance governed by min and annexed to your Lord
words.root_gloss_range: apportioned sustenance, giving, livelihood; locally supplied share from the Lord

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: your Lord in the command core

words.prose: {{ar:رِّزْقِ}} ({{tr:rizqi}}) reclassifies the gardens as apportioned sustenance. It sits between {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}) and {{ar:رَبِّكُمْ}} ({{tr:rabbikum}}), joining consumption to attribution: what is eaten is a supplied share, not raw environment or self-owned produce. The same provision thread continues into Saba-surah debate over the giver and supply (34:24; 34:36; 34:39), while 2:172 gives the eat-from-provision parallel.

topics.headline: apportioned supply, not bare produce
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that abundance is named as granted livelihood before it becomes food for use.
topics.reason: The noun is governed by min and carries provision logic of giver, recipient, and dependence.

topics.headline: provision bound to your Lord
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices provision functioning as the middle term that keeps ecology and lordship from being read apart.
topics.reason: The noun is the first term of an iḍāfah whose complement is the Lord noun.

topics.headline: Saba provision thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this local provision vocabulary opens a wider Saba-surah thread about the giver and debates over supply (34:24; 34:36; 34:39).
topics.reason: The recurrence rows connect local provision to lordship and gratitude here and to later provision language in the same surah; 2:172 gives a concrete eat-from-provision parallel.

words.gloss_range: your Lord in genitive iḍāfah, with second-person plural suffix shifting the report into address
words.root_gloss_range: lordship as ownership, nurture, governance, and sustaining care; locally the source-owner of provision

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: Lord noun in the final evaluation

words.prose: {{ar:رَبِّكُمْ}} ({{tr:rabbikum}}) names the provider as your Lord inside the command core. The suffix shifts Saba from third-person topic into direct address, and the lordship field makes provision governed care. Standing between eating and thanking, the giver centers the response; the same Lord will return as {{ar:رَبٌّ}} ({{tr:rabbun}}) in the final evaluation, while 2:21 shows lordship grounding worship through creation.

topics.headline: Saba becomes direct addressee
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices history becoming address: the old community is spoken to as responsible receivers.
topics.reason: The second-person plural suffix is the possessive complement and aligns with the plural imperatives.

topics.headline: provision under sustaining lordship
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that provision is not luck or environment alone but care under sustaining ownership.
topics.reason: The iḍāfah grammar binds provision to the Lord, and the lexical field supports nurture and governance.

topics.headline: Lord between eating and thanks
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the giver centered between eating and gratitude, then widened from your Lord to a Lord in the closing verdict.
topics.reason: The rows track local placement in the command core, the later echo to the closing noun, and a lordship-grounded worship parallel (2:21).

words.gloss_range: conjunction coordinating the gratitude command with the eating command
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) makes gratitude co-required with eating. It does not append a private feeling after satisfaction; it binds use of provision and acknowledgment of the provider into one response-unit.

topics.headline: eating and gratitude as one response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that consumption without thanks is structurally incomplete.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the second plural imperative with the first and keeps the two commands paired.

words.gloss_range: second-person plural imperative of gratitude, directed by the following lām-pronoun phrase
words.root_gloss_range: gratitude as manifested benefit-response; locally communal enacted acknowledgment to the provider
words.prose: {{ar:ٱشْكُرُوا۟}} ({{tr:ishkurū}}) turns received provision into required response. Its recipient is expressed by {{ar:لَهُۥ}} ({{tr:lahu}}), so thanks is aimed at the giver, and the plural imperative makes gratitude communal and enacted rather than merely inward. Because provision is named before gratitude, thanks answers received supply rather than inventing merit; 14:7 and the Saba gratitude thread (34:13; 34:19) sharpen that sequence.

topics.headline: thanks aimed at the giver
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that gratitude has a grammatical destination, not just an emotional object.
topics.reason: The imperative takes a lām complement rather than a direct object, and the command pair plus pronoun phrase form one response architecture.

topics.headline: visible communal gratitude
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices gratitude as visible communal conduct answering provision, not just polite speech.
topics.reason: The root-field supports manifested response, and the second-person plural imperative makes it communal.

topics.headline: gratitude answers prior provision
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that provision precedes gratitude, so thanks answers received supply rather than inventing merit; 14:7 and the Saba-surah gratitude thread sharpen the payoff (34:13; 34:19).
topics.reason: The sequence places provision before the gratitude command, and the recurrence rows connect commanded thanks with rare gratitude and later complaint.

words.gloss_range: lām plus third-person masculine singular pronoun marking the recipient of gratitude

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: your Lord in the command core

words.prose: {{ar:لَهُۥ}} ({{tr:lahu}}) closes the command package by routing thanks back to the provider. The pronoun resumes {{ar:رَبِّكُمْ}} ({{tr:rabbikum}}), not the provision, so consumption is enclosed by attribution and ends in directed gratitude.

topics.headline: thanks directed to the Lord
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the syntax directs thanks away from the gardens and toward the giver.
topics.reason: The lām governs the pronoun after the gratitude imperative, and the pronoun antecedent is licensed as the Lord noun.

topics.headline: command ends with divine pronoun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the command unit moving from eating, through provision, to a final provider-directed endpoint.
topics.reason: The structural rows show the command beginning with eating from provision and closing with the recipient pronoun, while the pronoun field shifts obligation back to the Lord.

words.gloss_range: indefinite nominative land, town, or territory opening a compressed evaluative close
words.root_gloss_range: inhabited land, town, territory, and civic ground; locally a livable land-order evaluated as good
words.prose: {{ar:بَلْدَةٌۭ}} ({{tr:baldatun}}) turns the preceding gardens and commands into a verdict: a good land. The noun joins terrain and community into a civic-ecological unit, while its indefiniteness classifies Saba’s place by quality; the accusative variant can be kept as a praise-like contrast, but the local reading remains nominative evaluation.

topics.headline: compressed good-land evaluation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the scene summarized as an evaluative verdict, not merely continued inventory.
topics.reason: The noun is nominative in a verbless evaluative close and begins the land-Lord pair.

topics.headline: land and settlement as one order
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sign is a livable land order where ecological fitness and moral legibility belong together; 7:58 and 90:1 supply concrete parallels.
topics.reason: The lexical field gathers land, settlement, and territory, and the closing pair combines land quality with Lordly mercy.

topics.headline: variant praise construction as apparatus
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the accusative-span reading can highlight praise, while it does not displace the standard nominative evaluation.
topics.reason: The row is retained as a reading contrast; the aligned local grammar gives the final nouns nominative evaluative force.

words.gloss_range: feminine adjective agreeing with the land noun and naming wholesome, stable fitness
words.root_gloss_range: pleasant, pure, wholesome, lawful, fertile; locally ecological and moral suitability of the land

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: land noun in the closing evaluation

words.prose: {{ar:طَيِّبَةٌۭ}} ({{tr:ṭayyibatun}}) is locked to {{ar:بَلْدَةٌۭ}} ({{tr:baldatun}}) by agreement, so land-goodness remains distinct from the Lord’s forgiveness. Its sensory-ethical range names the land as wholesome and fit to inhabit, and its stable adjectival form keeps the quality from sounding seasonal or accidental. The word also answers provision vocabulary by tying what is eaten to the environment that yields it, with 2:172 supplying a wholesome-provision-and-thanks parallel.

topics.headline: goodness belongs to the land
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the closing attributes do not collapse: land is wholesome, the Lord is forgiving.
topics.reason: The adjective agrees with the land noun in gender, number, case, and definiteness.

topics.headline: sensory-ethical land fitness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices land quality as fertility, pleasantness, purity, and moral fitness at once.
topics.reason: The lexical field supports wholesome/pure/pleasant/fertile quality, and the adjectival form presents a settled quality.

topics.headline: wholesome land answers provision
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that what is eaten is tied back to the environment that yields it, with 2:172 giving a concrete wholesome-provision-and-thanks parallel.
topics.reason: The rows connect the land adjective with provision and gratitude fields without making the adjective modify anything other than the land noun.

words.gloss_range: conjunction coordinating the Lord phrase with the good-land phrase
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) refuses to let the ayah end with ecology alone. It coordinates the forgiving Lord with the good land, making the final evaluation a two-member land-and-Lord seal.

topics.headline: good land paired with forgiving Lord
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that ecological goodness is completed by its governing source of mercy.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the second nominative phrase with the first in the closing nominal evaluation.

words.gloss_range: indefinite nominative Lord noun coordinated with the land noun and qualified by forgiveness

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: your Lord in the command core

words.prose: {{ar:رَبٌّ}} ({{tr:rabbun}}) balances the land noun as the second member of the close. Indefiniteness magnifies the quality, the following attribute defines lordship by forgiveness, and the shift from {{ar:رَبِّكُمْ}} ({{tr:rabbikum}}) to {{ar:رَبٌّ}} ({{tr:rabbun}}) widens addressed relationship into objective evaluation before the refusal in 34:16.

topics.headline: Lordship qualified by forgiveness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the closing Lord is not bare authority but sustaining authority characterized by mercy.
topics.reason: The noun is coordinated with the land noun and immediately modified by the forgiveness attribute.

topics.headline: forgiving Lord before refusal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 34:16 turns away from a forgiving sustainer already named inside the gift, not from an absent source of mercy.
topics.reason: The inter-ayah sequence explicitly links the closing Lord-and-forgiveness phrase to the next narrative turn (34:16).

topics.headline: setting matched with source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah ends with setting and source paired, and that your Lord becomes a Lord in the evaluative close.
topics.reason: The rows track the balanced nominal pair and the echo from the addressed Lord in the command to the closing evaluative title.

words.gloss_range: intensive adjective modifying the Lord noun and sealing the ayah with abundant forgiveness
words.root_gloss_range: covering, protecting, forgiving; locally abundant and enduring pardon as the Lord’s closing quality

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: Lord noun in the final evaluation

words.prose: {{ar:غَفُورٌۭ}} ({{tr:ghafūrun}}) is the final attribute and the ayah lands on mercy. Agreement ties it to {{ar:رَبٌّ}} ({{tr:rabbun}}), the covering image makes forgiveness protective, and the intensive pattern presents durable abundance of pardon before the reversal in 34:16. The provision-and-forgiveness field also recalls the rain-linked appeal for forgiveness in 71:10, so the rupture is read against available mercy rather than its absence.

topics.headline: forgiveness modifies the Lord
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final cadence defines the Lord by forgiveness, not merely by provision.
topics.reason: The adjective agrees with the Lord noun and participates in the repeated nominative cadence of the closing phrase.

topics.headline: protective abundant pardon
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices mercy as protective covering and abundant enduring forgiveness before fault is exposed.
topics.reason: The root field supports covering into pardon, and the intensive adjective pattern supports abundant durability.

topics.headline: forgiveness before refusal and loss
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 34:16 is read against available mercy, while 71:10 supplies a concrete forgiveness-and-rain parallel.
topics.reason: The rows connect forgiveness with provision and make the following rupture (34:16) a refusal after mercy has already been named.

branches.scope_ar: يدخل فيه أصل الستر والتغطية والصون، وما يغطي الرأس أو الخمار أو الوتر أو السحاب، وجعل المتاع في وعاء أو جعل الثوب أحمل للوسخ.
branches.scope_en: Includes the root image of covering, shielding, and protecting, including covers for the head, veil, bowstring groove, cloud cover, putting goods in a container, and making cloth better able to hide dirt.

variants.scope_ar: يدخل فيه أصل الستر والتغطية والصون، وما يغطي الرأس أو الخمار أو الوتر أو السحاب، وجعل المتاع في وعاء أو جعل الثوب أحمل للوسخ.
variants.scope_en: Includes the root image of covering, shielding, and protecting, including covers for the head, veil, bowstring groove, cloud cover, putting goods in a container, and making cloth better able to hide dirt.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence from maskan through the two gardens, eating, provision, gratitude, good town, and Lord.
baseline_models.mechanism: An inhabited place is flanked by food-bearing gardens; eating converts apportioned sustenance into life, while gratitude returns recognition to the cultivating Lord. The good town is the communal condition in which source, use, and response remain coupled.

activation_trace.role: Inhabiting a home fixes the provisioning circuit at the scale of settled communal life.
Taking food is the circuit's use and incorporation node, not merely a view of abundance.
Apportioned giving identifies the food as received provision rather than autonomous possession.
Cultivation, repair, and completion supply the sustaining agency behind both provision and town.
Recognition and manifestation of benefit close the human response side of the circuit.
The bounded land turns the mechanism from private feeding into a civic ecology.
Good, wholesome quality names the integrated condition of the inhabited land.

changed_reading.before: A fertile town offers food and asks its residents to give thanks.
changed_reading.after: The ayah presents a settled provisioning circuit: cultivated gift becomes nourishment, responsive gratitude, and a wholesome communal habitat.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Jannatan at the right and left, followed by a forgiving Lord.
baseline_models.mechanism: The settlement is materially enclosed by two garden-covers: the right activates blessing and potency, while the left activates all-around inclusion. This botanical protection is echoed by forgiveness as a covering that shields a person from the effect of fault.

activation_trace.role: The garden's root-image of a protective cover makes the paired gardens a sheltering boundary.
The right flank contributes blessing and fortunate potency to one side of the enclosure.
The left flank contributes encompassing inclusion, completing protection from the other side.
Forgiveness adds a moral cover that protects the inhabitant from a fault's destructive effect.

changed_reading.before: The two gardens mark a favorable location on both sides of the settlement.
changed_reading.after: The dwelling is nested inside complementary material and moral covers: bilateral garden protection and a Lord's protective forgiveness.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Kulu from the Lord's rizq and give shukr to Him.
baseline_models.mechanism: The branch inventory lets gratitude be read as a yield-response: little input becomes visibly effective, fresh growth appears, and nourishment matures. Coupled to eating and cultivating lordship, shukr is not only speech but the manifestation of received provision as renewed life.

activation_trace.role: Sufficiency from little input and its visible effect make gratitude a multiplier-like response.
Fresh shoots give that response a concrete image of renewed outward growth.
Crop yield links the command to eat with the productive output of the gardens.
Provision as descending rain supplies an ecological input behind the edible yield.
The non-dominant mapped branch of feeding and growth supplies the maturation process.

changed_reading.before: Gratitude is an acknowledgement spoken after consuming provision.
changed_reading.after: Gratitude is also the visible, efficient conversion of received provision into renewed growth and flourishing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: There was in their maskan an ayah: the two gardens and the ensuing imperative-description sequence.
baseline_models.mechanism: The sign is located inside ordinary habitation and consists of an arranged relation among dwelling, flanking gardens, use, response, land, and Lord. The ayah is therefore an inhabitable configuration, not an isolated marvel detached from daily life.

activation_trace.role: A visible marker makes the whole following arrangement evidentiary.
A place of settled stability locates the evidence within lived habitat.
The tree-covered gardens provide the sign's inspectable material structure.
The bounded town makes the sign a spatial and communal arrangement.

changed_reading.before: A remarkable pair of gardens serves as a sign for Saba.
changed_reading.after: The sign is the lived arrangement itself: a dwelling-scale interface joining ecology, consumption, gratitude, civic quality, and lordship.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding work scene explicitly couples intentional making with shukr and contrasts it with the small number of truly grateful servants. This strengthens the focus imperative into practiced stewardship: gratitude is enacted by maintaining and rightly using the conditions that feed the town.

activation_trace.role: The focus command supplies gratitude as recognition and manifestation of received benefit.
Intentional action turns gratitude from a verbal response into a mode of concrete making.
The explicit work-shukr coupling names recognition of benefit as the work's governing response.
Small number and scarcity mark enacted gratitude as a demanding, uncommon achievement.

structural_cues: 34:13 places an imperative to work directly beside shukr and then says the shakur are few.
34:15 repeats the shukr imperative after permission to eat, moving the work-response pattern into a town's food system.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the explicit work-shukr coupling and the later eat-shukr coupling; I infer that maintaining and using the habitat well is gratitude's civic form. A live alternative is that 34:13 names gratitude as the purpose or state of work without specifying ecological maintenance.

changed_reading.before: Residents should acknowledge the giver after enjoying the gardens.
changed_reading.after: Residents are summoned to perform gratitude through the skilled use, upkeep, and responsive continuation of the provisioning habitat.

context_deltas.mechanism: Turning one's side away is followed by the substitution of two gardens for two gardens: the spatial shell remains named alike while edible quality collapses. The covering-of-benefit branch of kufr makes the reversal exact: concealing gift changes a wholesome provisioning sign into a low-yield counter-sign.

activation_trace.role: Wholesome goodness identifies the initial habitat's integrated quality.
Protective forgiveness keeps moral recoverability present before the narrated reversal.
Turning the side away supplies the relational break that opens the reversal sequence.
One thing standing in another's place preserves the two-garden form while replacing its quality.
The repeated garden image makes the replacement a changed ecology rather than simple absence.
Crop yield becomes the diagnostic variable by which the replacement gardens differ.
Covering a benefit names the failed response that functionally inverts grateful manifestation.

structural_cues: 34:16 repeats the dual-garden construction but changes its produce after an explicit turning away.
34:17 interprets the replacement as recompense for kufr, creating a direct shukr-kufr response contrast with 34:15.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a turn, flood, substitution, degraded produce, and recompense; I infer that civic goodness is relationally maintained and therefore reversible. The replacement could also be read primarily as imposed judgment rather than ecological feedback, so the mechanism should not erase divine agency.

changed_reading.before: Good town describes a stable possession whose abundance demonstrates favor.
changed_reading.after: Good town names a recoverable but non-automatic habitat condition: the same garden form can remain while its nourishing quality is reversed when gift is covered rather than manifested.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the surah, visible signhood attaches not only to flourishing but also to threatened surroundings and the memory of fragmentation. Return, patient restraint, and gratitude are reader-dispositions that let the same habitat remain legible before, during, and after loss.

activation_trace.role: The focus marks the thriving dwelling arrangement as visible evidence.
A visible marker in the surrounding threat expands signhood beyond pleasant abundance.
Habitual return supplies the receptive posture by which a surrounding configuration becomes a sign.
Tearing into dispersed pieces turns destroyed social geography into retrospective evidence.
The plural visible markers explicitly classify the aftermath as sign-bearing.
Holding oneself from panic enables sustained reading when the sign appears through loss.
Recognition of benefit enables comparison between flourishing gift and its covered aftermath.

structural_cues: 34:9 calls the full before-behind and sky-earth surround a sign for one who returns.
34:15 locates a sign in a thriving dwelling.
34:19 calls the community's fragmentation signs for every patient and grateful reader.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies three sign scenes and their reader postures; I infer that signhood lies in a reversible relation and its history, not only in a positive object. A live alternative is that each scene is an independent proof with no intended temporal model.

changed_reading.before: The flourishing gardens themselves are the sign.
changed_reading.after: The sign is the habitat's legible history: flourishing, vulnerability, reversal, and remembered fragmentation all disclose the relation between gift and response.

context_deltas.mechanism: The good dwelling expands into a measured, secure route network; the request to manufacture distance is followed by social tearing. The surah's close then reverses their wish: the Lord is near, seizure comes from a near place, attempted appropriation from a distant place cannot reach, and a barrier finally interposes. Nearness is thus part of the habitat's mercy and timely accessibility.

activation_trace.role: A place of settled stability anchors the focus in accessible habitation rather than isolated abundance.
Deliberate apportioning of travel supplies a designed rhythm of reachable stages.
Settled confidence makes route accessibility a form of lived security.
Actively producing distance is the requested deformation of the near route network.
Tearing into pieces realizes manufactured distance as communal and geographic fragmentation.
Divine nearness preserves the positive pole of accessible relation at the surah's close.
Reaching by extension names the now-failed attempt to take hold of belief or rescue.
Distance explains why the attempted reach is no longer timely or effective.
A separating barrier is the terminal form of the accessibility they earlier asked to undo.

structural_cues: 34:18 presents visible settlements, measured travel, and safety by night and day.
34:19 immediately links requested distance with self-wronging and dispersion.
34:50-54 repeatedly oppose nearness, distance, failed reach, and final interposition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies designed travel, requested distancing, dispersion, near/far reach language, and a final barrier; I infer a single accessibility mechanism joining them. The close may primarily concern temporal nearness to judgment rather than civic geography, so the spatial echo remains analogical rather than identity.

changed_reading.before: A good town is a fertile and secure local residence.
changed_reading.after: A good town is also an architecture of timely nearness: provision, neighboring stages, safety, response, and forgiveness remain within reach before chosen distance hardens into separation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Provision descends through the sky-earth order, is expanded or constricted, exits possession as expenditure, and is followed by replacement. Eating in the focus is one legitimate throughput within this larger circulation; the good town receives, uses, and releases provision rather than treating abundance as a self-securing stock.

activation_trace.role: Apportioned gift identifies the garden food as one moment in a larger provisioning flow.
Eating is the embodied use-stage through which provision sustains recipients.
Provision sourced through heavens and earth places the town inside a wider vertical economy of gift.
Expansion, increase, and surplus supply the widening phase of provision.
Constriction to a small measure supplies the narrowing phase without changing the giver.
The exit of wealth in expenditure turns possession outward into circulation.
Something coming after and taking the spent thing's place keeps release from being the circuit's endpoint.
Repeated provisioning language identifies expansion, spending, and replacement as one governed flow.

structural_cues: 34:24 locates provisioning in the sky-earth relation.
34:36 and 34:39 repeat expansion and constriction of rizq.
34:39 adds expenditure, replacement, and the superlative provider, while 34:35-37 deny that accumulated wealth itself guarantees safety or nearness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies source, expansion, constriction, expenditure, and replacement; I infer a circulation norm that revises static ownership. Replacement may be non-material or deferred, so this is not a promise of immediate commercial return.

changed_reading.before: Eat from the stored abundance that belongs to your town.
changed_reading.after: Receive and use one share of a moving provision whose source exceeds the town and whose healthy social form includes release rather than hoarding.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links a material dual garden to a later discipline of thinking in pairs through branch recurrence, not through explicit syntax. It remains validly anchored in jannatan and ayah, with 34:46 supplying pairing, reflection, and a contrasting JNN branch. Downstream prose should present it as an epistemic analogy, not claim that the gardens lexically mean a reasoning method.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The dual form jannatan as the visible ayah between right and left.

activation_trace.role: Two tree-covered gardens provide the paired material objects available for comparative attention.
Their arrangement is explicitly marked as visible evidence to be read.
Joining one to one as two activates pairing as an epistemic posture rather than mere quantity.
The heart's repeated turning supplies the comparative act performed on the pair.
The denied covering of reason creates a sharp cross-branch contrast with the garden-cover that invites reflection.

changed_reading.before: The number two reports how many gardens Saba possessed.
changed_reading.after: The paired gardens can also function as a built prompt to compare two flanks and think through balance, enclosure, and response.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the same eating root moves across nourishment, silent corrosion, and degraded crop yield. It remains anchored in the focus imperative kulu and in exact whole-surah occurrences immediately around it. Downstream prose should distinguish these modes and must not imply that the commanded eating in 34:15 is itself destructive.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The imperative kulu from the Lord's provision.

activation_trace.role: Taking nourishment is the focus's constructive mode of consumption.
Corrosion and decay turn eating into a silent process that removes a support and exposes hidden fragility.
The hidden agents become exposed when corrosive consumption brings the supporting structure down.
Crop yield becomes degraded output, showing that not every available consumption loop is wholesome.

changed_reading.before: Eating simply confirms that the gardens are beneficial.
changed_reading.after: Eating is diagnostic: it can nourish a grateful circuit, silently consume its supports, or register the bitter output of a reversed ecology.

strongest_changes: Gratitude became intentional work that maintains and rightly uses a provisioning habitat.
The good town became a reversible quality: identical garden form can persist while nourishing function collapses.
The sign expanded from prosperous object to a history legible through warning, flourishing, fragmentation, patience, and gratitude.
Measured nearness and circulation emerged as civic dimensions of goodness, while chosen distance, hoarding, and failed reach mark breakdown.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet turned a compact garden tableau into a worked, reversible, connected, and circulating habitat. The most distinctive activations were the near-far closure in 34:18-19 and 34:50-54, and the three sharply different modes of eating across 34:14-16.
remaining_uncertainties: The yield-like branches of shukr support an ecological feedback reading, but they do not by themselves prove a causal agricultural claim.
The closing near-far sequence may be primarily temporal and eschatological; its civic-spatial resonance with Saba remains analogical.
The paired-reflection outlier is intentionally exploratory and should not be rendered as lexical equivalence.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Habitation is a balanced container of provision.** `س ك ن/B002` is settlement, `ي م ن/B002` the right side, `ش م ل/B006` the left, `ر ز ق/B002` nourishing food, and `ب ل د/B001` a bounded tract. The dwelling is flanked by two gardens, followed by eating and gratitude. Settlement supplies the center, the paired sides balance intake, and the bounded tract contains the system. The packet gives the arrangement; I infer that bilateral cultivation stabilizes habitation. The sign reads as an inhabited provisioning design, not merely attractive scenery.
2. **Forgiveness is resilience within the good system.** `ط ي ب/B001` is purity against foulness and `غ ف ر/B001` protective covering. Their nominal close assigns environmental quality to the town and protective tolerance to its Lord. I infer that the system can absorb ordinary failure without immediate collapse. The ayah preserves both flourishing and moral recoverability.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 34:16 immediately removed the protective resilience by reversing storage into discharge, showing that forgiveness in 34:15 is not a guarantee against deliberate system-level refusal.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The settlement enclosed in ecological armor.** `ج ن ن B008` supplies protective cover, `ي م ن B002` the right side, and `ش م ل B001` all-around encompassing. Two gardens explicitly flank the settlement; nearby 34:11 has broad linked armor, and 34:13 has enclosing vessels. The branches assign the gardens the same protective role at habitat scale. The packet supplies lateral placement and prior covers; I infer that edible vegetation buffers the dwelling as ecological armor. The sign reads as protected settlement design, not merely two scenic orchards.

2. **Gratitude as resilience under little.** `ش ك ر B002` supplies being sustained by little while making its effect visible. The command is issued amid abundance, but 34:16 immediately retains only a little lote after the garden exchange. The branch makes gratitude the practice that can carry benefit across contraction. The packet supplies the command and the little remainder; I infer that gratitude is a condition of resilient use rather than a reaction to quantity. This changes the command from etiquette after eating into a principle for sustaining provision.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 34:16's `سِدْرٍ قَلِيلٍ` directly activated `ش ك ر B002`, making the later scarcity a test of whether little can still show sustaining effect. 34:18 then widened the ecological cover into a secure network of settlements.

baseline.text: Sebe halkı için yurtlarında bir işaret vardı: sağda ve solda iki bahçe. ‘Rabbinizin rızkından yiyin ve O'na şükredin.’ Güzel bir ülke ve bağışlayan bir Rab.

findings.text: Yerleşim, sağ ve soldaki iki üretken bahçenin dengelediği, sınırları belli bir beslenme düzeninin merkezidir.
İki bahçe, yurdu yalnız beslemekle kalmayıp iki yandan kuşatan ekolojik bir koruma tabakası oluşturur.
Şükür, bolluğa bağlı bir tepki olmaktan çıkıp, kaynak azaldığında bile yararı sürdürebilen bir dayanıklılık ilkesi olur.
Bağışlamanın yerleşim düzeninin sıradan aksaklıkları emerek hemen çökmesini önleyen sistemsel bir esneklik olduğu okuması ayette yeterince temellenmez.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü bir yerde yerleşip yaşamayı, yaşanan yeri, birini orada oturtmayı ve bir evi karşılıksız kullanıma bırakmayı birlikte bildirir. Dal çerçevesi bunları yerleşme ve konut ekseninde doğru biçimde toplar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Burada odak, yerleşme eylemi ve yaşanan yerdir; orada yaşayan kişiler ya da iç dinginlik bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın yerleşip yaşama anlamını temel alır; konut, birini oturtma ve karşılıksız kullanım verme biçimlerini aynı söz ailesinin açık uzantıları olarak gösterir.

concept_map.definition: Bir yere yerleşip orada yaşama ve o yeri yaşanan yer edinmedir. Aynı alan, yaşanan yerin kendisini, birini oraya yerleştirmeyi ve bir evi kira almadan kullanımına vermeyi de kapsar.

facets.statement: Kişi bir yere yerleşir ve orada yaşamını sürdürür.
Yerleşilip yaşanan ev veya yer, bu eylemin yer adı olarak anlatılır.
Birini bir yerde oturtma ve evi kira almadan kullanımına verme de bu alanın ettirgen ve hukuki uzantılarıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yerleşip yaşama eylemini, yaşanan ev veya yeri, bir başkasını oraya yerleştirmeyi ve bir evi kira karşılığı olmadan kullanımına bırakmayı aynı anlam alanında birleştirir.

error_profile.preserves: Bir yere yerleşme ile orada yaşamayı tek süreç içinde korur.

error_profile.preserves: Yerleşilip yaşanan yer olma niteliğini korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü evde yaşayanları, ev halkını ve bakmakla yükümlü olunan aile üyelerini açıkça dalın gönderimi yapar. Çerçeve, evi ya da yerleşme eylemini değil o yerde yaşayan insan topluluğunu doğru biçimde ayırır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, evin kendisini değil evde yaşayanları ve ev halkını anlatır; genel akrabalık veya her tür topluluk bağı daha geniştir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım ev halkını yalın çekirdek olarak verir; çoğul sakinler ve evde yaşayanları belirten kalıp kullanımı bu çekirdeğin ayrı gerçekleşmeleridir.

concept_map.definition: Bir evde yaşayan kişiler, özellikle aynı evin halkı ve aile yükümlülüğü içinde bulunan kimselerdir. Daha genel çoğul kullanım, belirli bir yerde oturanların tümünü gösterebilir.

facets.statement: Gönderim, evin kendisine değil o evde yaşayan kişilere yönelir.
Aynı evin halkı ve bakmakla yükümlü olunan aile üyeleri bu grubun belirgin özel alanıdır.
Çoğul kullanım, bir evde veya başka bir yerde oturanların tümüne genişleyebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak anlatımı, sözü ev halkı, aile üyeleri ve evde ya da belirli bir yerde oturan kişiler için kullanır; fiziksel ev ile içindeki topluluk açıkça ayrılır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Evde yaşayan topluluğu hem aile halkı hem de daha genel oturanlar yönüyle karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Evin içindeki kişileri, aile halkı ile genel oturanlar kapsamını birlikte korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü kişinin içinin yöneldiği ve yanında dinginleştiği sevgiliyi ya da şeyi temel alır; gece, yakarış ve ateş bunun örnekleridir. Dal çerçevesi bu rahatlatıcı ve yakınlık veren dayanağı doğru yakalar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Odak iç dinginliği sağlayan kişi veya şeydir; yalnız fiziksel durma, ağırbaşlı iç durum ya da salt sıcaklık değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın olarak kişinin yanında rahatlayıp dinginleştiği dayanağı verir; gece, yakarış ve ateş kullanımları ile ateşle düzeltme ayrı bağlamlara bağlı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Kişinin yakınlık duyup yanında rahatladığı, içinin yatıştığı kişi veya şeydir. Gece, destekleyici yakarış ve yanında oturulan ateş bu rahatlatıcı işlevle adlandırılabilir.

facets.statement: Kişi sevdiği veya yakın bulduğu birine ya da şeye yönelir ve onun yanında içi yatışır.
Gece ve destekleyici yakarış, dinlenme veya güven verme işlevleriyle aynı adlandırma alanına girer.
Yanında oturulup yakınlık ve rahatlık bulunan ateş bu anlamın somut bir gerçekleşmesidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar kişinin sevdiği veya yakın bulduğu şeyin yanında içinin yatışmasını ortak çekirdek yapar; geceyi, destekleyici yakarışı ve ateşi bu rahatlatıcı işlevin örnekleri olarak verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişi, zaman, sözlü destek veya ateşin insana yakınlık ve iç rahatlığı vermesi ortak çekirdeğini karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Rahatlatan dayanağı ve insanın ona yönelerek içinin yatışmasını birlikte korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü ağırbaşlılık, yumuşak başlılık, güven ve kalbin yatışmasını aynı iç durum çevresinde birleştirir. Sandık içindeki şeyin insanlara güven verip kaçmalarını önlemesi bu çekirdeğin özel anlatısıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal dış hareketin yalnızca durmasını değil, güvenle birleşen ağırbaşlı ve dingin iç durumu anlatır; yoksulluk ve ezilmişlik ayrı kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım ağırbaşlı iç dinginliği yalın çekirdek yapar; kalbe verilmesi ve sandıktaki güven verici şey yalnız kendi kalıpları içinde tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Korku ve taşkınlığın yerini güvenin, ağırbaşlılığın ve yumuşak bir iç dinginliğinin almasıdır. Kalbe verilen güven ile topluluğu bir arada tutan sandık içeriği bu durumun özel anlatımlarıdır.

facets.statement: İç dünyada güven, dinginlik ve ağırbaşlılık birlikte belirir.
Kalbin korkudan kurtulup güven duyması bu iç durumun belirgin gerçekleşmesidir.
Bir sandığın içindeki güven verici şey, insanların kalplerini yatıştırıp onları bir arada tutması bakımından adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ağırbaşlılık, yumuşak başlılık, güven ve kalp dinginliğini ortak bir iç durum olarak sunar; kalbe güven verilmesi ve sandıktaki güven verici şey bunun özel anlatılarıdır.

error_profile.preserves: İç dinginliği güven ve ağırbaşlılıkla birlikte korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü yoksulluk halini, güçsüzlük ve ezilmişliği, ayrıca kişinin boyun eğip kendini aşağı koymasını aynı dalda açıkça sayar. Dal çerçevesi maddi yoksunluk ile toplumsal veya iradi boyun eğme arasındaki bağı korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal hem yoksulluğu hem ezilmiş ve güçsüz durumu kapsar; ağırbaşlı iç dinginlik ya da evde yaşama anlamları buna dahil değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın tek anlam varsaymaz; yoksul kişi ve yoksulluk durumunu, ezilmişlik ile boyun eğme bildiren türemiş eylemlerden açıkça ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Geçim araçlarından yoksun olma veya güçsüz, ezilmiş ve aşağı durumda bulunmadır. Bu durumdan hareketle kişinin boyun eğmesi ya da kendini aşağı koyması da aynı söz ailesinde anlatılır.

facets.statement: Kişi geçim araçlarından yoksun ve yardıma gerek duyan durumda olabilir.
Söz, maddi yoksunluktan bağımsız olarak güçsüzlük, ezilmişlik ve aşağı durumda bulunmayı da anlatabilir.
Kişinin boyun eğmesi, kendini aşağı koyması veya yoksul duruma gelmesi türemiş eylemlerle ifade edilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çerçevesi yoksul kişiyi ve yoksulluk durumunu güçsüzlük, ezilmişlik ve boyun eğmeyle ilişkilendirir; türemiş eylemler kişinin yoksullaşmasını veya kendini aşağı koymasını anlatır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Maddi yoksunluk ile aşağı ve güçsüz durumda bulunma yönlerini birlikte taşıyan dalın tam alanını karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Yoksulluğu, güçsüzlüğü ve ezilmişliği birbirine indirgemeden birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin geçim araçlarından yoksun oluşu ile zayıf toplumsal durumunun birlikte kastedildiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin hem maddi yoksunluğunu hem güçsüz durumunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin baskı veya bağlılık karşısında kendini güçsüz ve aşağı konuma koyduğu eylem bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Boyun eğme ile kendini aşağı konuma koyma eylemini birlikte korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal yoksulluğun yanında güçsüzlük, ezilmişlik ve boyun eğmeyi içerir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü kesici bıçağı doğrudan adlandırır ve adlandırmayı kesilen hayvanın hareketini ölümle sona erdirmesine bağlar. Dal çerçevesi aracı ve verilen köken açıklamasını koruyarak gemi parçasından ayırır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal kesici bıçak ile onu yapan kişiyi kapsar; gemi dengeleme parçası ya da kesme eyleminin kendisi değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım bıçak adını yalın araç anlamıyla verir; hayvanın hareketini sona erdirmeye dayalı ad açıklamasını çekirdeğin yerine geçirmeyen bağlı bir açıklama olarak tutar.

concept_map.definition: Kesmekte kullanılan ağızlı bıçaktır. Kaynaklar adını, kesilen hayvanın hareketini ölümle sona erdirmesi üzerinden açıklar; aracı yapan kişi de ayrı bir türemiş adla gösterilir.

facets.statement: Gönderim, kesmekte kullanılan ağızlı bıçaktır.
Adın kökeni, bıçağın kesilen hayvanın hareketini ölümle sona erdirmesine bağlanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar kesici bıçağın bilinen araç olduğunu ortaklaşa belirtir ve adlandırılmasını, kesilen hayvanın hareketini sona erdirme sonucuyla açıklar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın araç gönderimini kısa ve doğal biçimde karşılar; adın köken açıklaması tanımda ayrıca korunur.

error_profile.preserves: Kesmekte kullanılan ağızlı araç olma çekirdeğini eksiksiz korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kesme araçlarını, kılıcı, kısa geniş ağzı ve kesik oku kapsayan daha geniş bir araç ve ağız alanıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal keskin ağızla kesme işlevi gören elde kullanılan araçları kapsayabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak belirli bıçak türünün genel adıdır; komşu farklı kesici araçları ve keskin ağız biçimlerini daha geniş bir kümede toplar.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bıçak, kesme işini komşu dalın gösterdiği keskin kenar sayesinde yapar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak araç bütünüdür, komşu ise aracın kesen kenarı veya ucudur; parça ile bütün aynı gönderime sahip değildir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal kesme aracını adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal hayvanın boyun kemiğini kesme işlemini adlandırır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal hayvan kesme olayında araç ve işlem olarak birlikte yer alabilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü geminin kıçındaki, onu dengede tutup çalkantısını azaltan bölüm veya aracı açıkça verir. Dal çerçevesi bu gemiye özgü gönderimi ve dengeleme işlevini kesici bıçak anlamından doğru biçimde ayırır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal yalnız geminin kıçındaki dengeleyici ve yöneltici bölüm ya da araçla ilgilidir; geminin tamamını veya genel durma eylemini adlandırmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım gemi parçasının özel adını yalın biçimde korur; gemiyle kurulan kalıp ifade aynı parçayı işleviyle belirleyen kullanımdır ve genel durma anlamına genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Geminin kıçında bulunan, gemiyi dengede tutmaya, yöneltmeye ve çalkantısını azaltmaya yarayan bölüm veya araçtır. Adlandırma doğrudan bu dengeleme işlevine bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Gönderim geminin kıçında bulunan belirli bir bölüm veya araçtır.
Bu bölüm veya araç gemiyi dengeler, yöneltir ve çalkantısını azaltır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar geminin kıçındaki bu bölüm veya aracı ortaklaşa tanımlar; temel işlevi gemiyi ayarlamak, dengede tutmak ve çalkantısını azaltmaktır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Parçanın gemideki yerini ve gemiyi dengeleyip yöneltme işlevini birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Kıçtaki araç olmayı, dengeleme ve yöneltme işlevleriyle birlikte korur.

error_profile.preserves: Geminin kıçındaki yerini ve denge sağlama işlevini kesin olmayan tür eşleştirmesi yapmadan korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü tek bir genel yer anlamından fazlasını içerir: özel bir yer adı, başın boyuna oturduğu nokta ve kalıplaşmış çoğul ifadelerde yerler, konumlar, düzeyler veya alışılmış düzen vardır. Dal korunabilir, ancak yalnız bu özel ve kalıplaşmış yerleşiklik kullanımlarının şemsiyesi olarak tanımlanmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal genel olarak evde yaşama anlamına genişletilemez; bedensel yerleşme noktası, kalıplaşmış konum anlatıları ve özel yer adıyla sınırlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım özel yer adını, bedensel yeri ve çoğul kalıp ifadeleri ayrı tutar; bunlardan genel bir yalın yerleşme anlamı çıkarmaz.

concept_map.definition: Sabit yer veya konum düşüncesine bağlı birkaç özel kullanımdır: başın boyuna oturduğu nokta, çoğul kalıplarda kişilerin yerleri, konumları, düzeyleri ya da alışılmış düzenleri ve belirli bir yer adı. Bunlar genel yerleşip yaşama eylemi değildir.

facets.statement: Başın boyuna oturduğu nokta, bedendeki belirli bir yerleşme yeri olarak adlandırılır.
Çoğul kalıp ifadeler kişilerin yerlerini, konumlarını, düzeylerini, evlerini veya alışılmış düzenlerini gösterebilir.
Aynı biçim, belirli bir bölgedeki özel yerin adı olarak da aktarılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak sözü sabit yer düşüncesine bağlı fakat birbirinden ayrılması gereken kullanımları verir: bedensel yerleşme noktası, çoğul kalıplarda yer ve düzen anlatımı ile belirli bir özel yer adı.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın tek bir yalın anlam olmadığını, bedensel yer, kalıplaşmış konum ve özel yer adı kullanımlarını bir şemsiye altında topladığını gösterir.

error_profile.preserves: Sabit yer ortaklığını ve kullanımların özel, birbirinden ayrılan yapısını birlikte korur.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalda da bir şeyin bulunduğu ya da kalıcı biçimde bağlı olduğu yer düşüncesi vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak yalnız özel ad ve kalıplarda yaşayan yer-konum kullanımlarını toplar; komşu gündelik ve üretken yerleşme ile konut alanıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal bedende özellikle başın boyuna oturduğu noktayı gösterir ve başka kalıplaşmış yer kullanımları da taşır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü yiyecek ve geçimlikleri, kişinin onların sayesinde yerinde kalabilmesiyle açıklar; bol otlak da topluluğu göç etmekten alıkoyduğu için aynı işlevsel çizgidedir. Dal çerçevesi besin ile yerinde kalma sonucunu doğru biçimde birleştirir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal her türlü yiyeceği veya otlağı değil, geçimi sürdürerek insanı ya da sürüyü bulunduğu yerde tutan yeterli besin kaynağını anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım geçimlik yiyecek biçimlerini yalın besin alanında, bol otlak kalıbını ise göçü gereksiz kılan özel hayvancılık bağlamında ayrı tutar.

concept_map.definition: İnsanın geçimini sürdürüp bulunduğu yerde kalmasını sağlayan yiyecek veya geçimliktir. Hayvancılık bağlamında, sürünün başka yere göç etmesini gerektirmeyecek kadar bol otlak aynı işlevle nitelenir.

facets.statement: Yiyecek veya geçimlik, kişinin yaşamını sürdürmesini ve bulunduğu yerde kalmasını sağlar.
Sürüyü göç ettirmeye gerek bırakmayacak kadar bol otlak, aynı yerinde tutma işleviyle nitelenir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek kaynaklı anlatım, yiyecek ve geçimliği kişinin yerinde kalmasını sağlayan destek olarak açıklar; bol otlağı da sürüyü başka yere götürme gereğini kaldırdığı için aynı çizgiye bağlar.

concept_gloss.text: yerinde kalmayı sağlayan geçimlik ve bol otlak
concept_gloss.applicability: İnsan için geçimlik yiyeceği ve sürü için göçü gereksiz kılan bol otlağı ortak işlevleriyle birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Besin kaynağını ve onun bulunduğu yerde kalmayı sağlama sonucunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İnsanın geçimini sürdürmesine ve bulunduğu yerde yaşamaya devam etmesine yarayan besinler kastedildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yaşamı sürdürmeye yarayan yiyeceklerin geçimlik işlevini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sürünün besin bulmak için başka yere götürülmesine gerek bırakmayan otlak anlatıldığında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Otlak bolluğunu ve bunun göç gereğini kaldırma sonucunu birlikte korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bedeni ayakta ve yaşamı sürer tutan yiyeceği, başkasını besleme eylemleriyle birlikte genel olarak kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: yerinde tutan geçimlik ile yaşatan yiyecek
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da yaşamı sürdürmek için gereken temel yiyecek ve geçimliği anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odakta yiyeceğin yer değiştirmeyi önleyip kalışı sağlaması belirgindir; komşuda temel sonuç bedenin ve yaşamın sürmesidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal yeterli geçimliği ve göçü gereksiz kılan bol otlağı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal insan veya hayvanın bir süre idare etmesini sağlayan az yiyeceği ve bahara kadar yeten sınırlı otlamayı öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal insanın veya hayvanın yaşamını sürdürmesine yetecek besin kaynağını anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak yerinde kalmaya yetecek kaynak ve hatta bolluk içerir; komşu özellikle kıt, geçici ve ancak idare ettiren miktara yönelir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal otlağın bol olup sürüyü bulunduğu yerde tutması koşulunu taşır ve insan geçimliğine de uzanır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal hayvanların yediği ot ve otlağı, bolluk veya yerinde tutma koşulu olmadan genel olarak adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: bol yerleşik otlak ile genel otlak
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalın hayvancılık alanında ortak gönderimi otlayan hayvana besin sağlayan bitki ve otlaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak yalnız göç gereğini kaldıracak bolluktaki otlağı niteler; komşu her tür ot ve otlak için genel addır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi oyalanma, durup bekleme, bir isin imkanini bekleme ve kalinan yer anlamlarini birlikte verir. Verilen dal cercevesi bu bekleme ve kalma cekirdegini sadik bicimde temsil eder.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal hedefe yonelme, isaret adi veya soru edati degil; bekleme ve kalma alanidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Bare kapsam, anlami kokten gelen bekleme ve kalma cekirdegiyle sinirlar; baska edat veya ad kullanimlari buraya alinmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir yerde veya bir isin basinda oyalanarak durmak, beklemek ya da kalinacak yer olarak tutulmak.

facets.statement: Kisi veya sey hareketi erteleyip durur, oyalanir ya da bekler.
Bir isin gerceklesme imkanini bekleme anlami da ayni durup bekleme cekirdegine baglidir.
Kalinan veya beklenilen yer icin konaklama ve tutulma yeri anlaminda adlasmis kullanim vardir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar dalin temelini durma, oyalanma ve bekleme olarak verir; ayrica bir isin imkanini bekleme ve kalinacak yer kullanimi ayni anlam alaninda yer alir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Durma, oyalanma, bekleme ve kalinan yer baglantisini en kisa bicimde tasir.

error_profile.preserves: Bekleme ve oyalanarak durma cekirdegini korur.
error_profile.loses: Kalinan yer olarak adlasmis kullanim tam olarak gorunmez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Fiil olarak kisinin hareket etmeyip bekledigi baglamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Durma ve bekleme eylemini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir isin olabilirligini bekleme baglaminda kullanilir.

error_profile.preserves: Isin imkanini bekleme yonunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yer adi olarak konaklama veya tutulma yeri anlaminda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Mekan ve kalma sonucunu korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dalda oyalanma ve isin imkanini bekleme de vardir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dalda bekleyisle birlikte daha belirgin sabitlik ve yerlesme vurgusu vardir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Ikisi de hareketin ertelenmesi ve bir yerde kalma alanina girer.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal bekleyerek oyalanmayi ve imkan kollamayi kapsar; komsu dal beklemeyle birlikte sabit durus ve yerlesme tarafini daha guclu kurar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal bekleme, oyalanma ve kisa sureli kalma durumuna aciktir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dalda bir yerde yerlesme, uzun kalma veya ikamet etme cekirdegi vardir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Ikisi de bir yerde bulunma ve kalma durumunu anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalin cekirdegi bekleyerek durma iken komsu dalin cekirdegi bir yerde ikamet veya uzun sureli yerlesik kalmadir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal bekleme ve oyalanmadir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal bir kisinin belirtisine veya kendisine yonelerek onu kastetmedir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Ikisi ayni kok ailesindeki sesce yakin formlardir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Anlam cekirdekleri ayridir: burada eylem durup beklemek, komsuda ise bir kisiyi hedef alarak kastetmektir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adaylar icinden bekleme ve kalma sinirini aciklastiranlar secildi; diger ic dallar ve uzak adaylar daha cok ses, edat veya genel alan benzerligi tasir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه تأيا بمعنى تمكث وتوقف، وتأيي الأمر بمعنى انتظار إمكانه، والتئية بمعنى مقام أو منزل تلبث.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir kisinin belirtisini ve sahsini amaclayarak ona yonelmeyi ve onu bilerek kastetmeyi bildirir. Dal cercevesi bu hedeflenmis kisiyi kastetme anlamini dogru ayirir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal beklemek veya yalniz bir isaret bildirmek degil, kisiyi belirtisiyle hedef almaktir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Bare kapsam, anlamin edat veya sabit kalipla degil fiilsel kastetme cekirdegiyle verilmesini gerektirir.

concept_map.definition: Bir kisinin belirtisini ve sahsini esas alarak onu bilerek hedeflemek ve kastetmek.

facets.statement: Eylemde belirli bir kisi secilir ve ona kasitli olarak yonelinir.
Kisiyi hedefleme, onun gorunen belirtisi veya sahsi uzerinden kurulur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu dali bir kisinin belirtisini ve sahsini hedefleyerek onu kastetme seklinde toplar; anlamda bilincli yonelme esastir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kisinin kendisini veya ayirt edici belirtisini esas alan kastetme eylemini karsilar.

error_profile.preserves: Kisiyi belirti ve sahis yonunden kasitli hedefleme cekirdegini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Belirli kisinin hedef alindigi fiil baglaminda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Belirli kisiyi kasitli hedefleme anlamini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal kisinin belirtisi ve sahsi uzerinden hedeflemeyi belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal daha genel olarak herhangi bir seye yonelme ve onda ciddi olma anlamina aciktir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Ikisi de bilerek yonelme ve hedef edinme alanini paylasir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal kisiye ve onun belirtisine bagli ozel bir kastetmedir; komsu dal hedef nesnesi bakimindan daha genis bir yonelme anlamidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal kisi sahsini ve belirtisini hedef alir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal yonelme, arama ve niyet etme gibi daha genis alanlari kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Ikisi de amacli yonelme anlaminda kesisir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalin siniri belirli kisiyi kastetmeye dardir; komsu dal genel hedefe gitme veya arama niyetini de tasir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal bir kisiyi hedeflemeyi anlatir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal isaret, belirti, topluluk veya metin birimi gibi adlasmis anlamlari anlatir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Kisinin belirtisi fikri iki dal arasinda bag kurar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalda belirti hedefleme araci olur; komsu dalda belirti veya isaret bizzat adlasmis anlamdir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Kastetme alanini ayiran en yakin genel yonelme adaylari ve ic isaret dali secildi; diger adaylar uzak veya yalniz bicimsel benzerliklidir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه تآييت أو تأييت الشخص إذا قصدت آيته وشخصه وتعمدته.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو التمكث والانتظار، ولا الآية بمعنى العلامة المجردة إلا من جهة كونها مقصودة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: تآييت وأصله تعمدت آيته وشخصه (maqayis)؛ تآييته وتأييته إذا قصدت آيته وتعمدته (sihah)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalniz soyut isaret degil, kisinin sahsi, topluca cikma, kitap parcasini olusturan harf toplulugu ve gunes isigini de ayni ailede verir. Dal adi kullanilabilir, fakat tanim isaret cekirdegini bu adlasmis ve kalipli uzantilardan ayirmalidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Isaret cekirdegi korunur; kisi, topluluk, metin parcasi ve gunes isigi kullanimlari buna bagli uzantilardir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mixed non-bare kapsam, yalniz ciplak isaret anlamini degil, kalipli kisi, topluluk, metin parcasi ve gunes isigi kullanimlarini ayri facetlerde tutar.

concept_map.definition: Gorunen bir belirti veya isaret; bazi kalipli kullanimlarda kisinin sahsi, toplulugun butunu, kitapta harflerden olusan parca ya da gunesin isigi icin de kullanilir.

facets.statement: Temel anlam, bir seyi tanitan veya ona delalet eden gorunen belirtidir.
Kisinin sahsi, onun taninmasini saglayan belirti gibi dusunulerek ifade edilir.
Bir toplulugun eksiksiz butunu icin de kullanilir.
Kitapta harf toplulugundan olusan belirli parca anlamina gelir.
Gunes isigi, gunesin ayirt ettirici belirtisi gibi goruldugu icin bu alana baglanir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar isaret ve belirti cekirdeginde bulusur; ayni iddia kisinin sahsi, toplulugun butunu, kitap parcasi ve gunes isigi gibi uzantilari da birlikte aktarir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Ciplak isaret anlamini iyi karsilar, fakat kalipli uzantilari tek basina tam tasimaz.

error_profile.preserves: Isaret ve belirti cekirdegini korur.

error_profile.preserves: Kisiye bagli ozel uzantiyi korur.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Ikisi de tanimaya yarayan belirti anlamini paylasir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal isaret cekirdeginden metin ve topluluk anlamlarina acilir; komsu dal ise bir seyi tanittiran alamet olma sinirinda kalir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dalda gorunen belirti veya isaretin kendisi one cikar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dalda belirti konusan delil gibi anlam aciga cikaran kanit niteligindedir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal isaretin varligini adlandirir; komsu dal isaretin anlam gosteren delil olma islevini daha guclu tasir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal isaret veya belirtinin kendisini anlatir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Burada belirti adlasmis cekirdektir; komsuda belirti, kisiyi kastetmenin aracidir.
